39b9713406338021.en: Assistant: 'If a substantive reply is impossible, no notification is needed.'
39b9713406338021.zh: 助手：“如果无法作实质答复，就不需要任何通知。”

25c4780e7f1b1f06.en: Compare the old memo with the current document package.
25c4780e7f1b1f06.zh: 将旧备忘录与最新材料进行比较。

1b8ef3fe34c8c489.zh: 确定剩余的组织实施步骤。

62cc7249d1dcba86.en: Prepare communication of the rules and schedule to residents through the responsible party.
62cc7249d1dcba86.zh: 准备由责任方向居民告知规则和时间表。

9180c8769a9c738e.en: Do not undertake new budget commitments on behalf of the reception office.
9180c8769a9c738e.zh: 不得代表接待处承担新的预算承诺。

3b28ee52462b7e4b.en: Verify the first service and its compliance with the route.
3b28ee52462b7e4b.zh: 核查首次服务是否完成及是否符合路线。

9ddbf9127d9bda10.en: Repeat the refusal from the old memo without analysis.
9ddbf9127d9bda10.zh: 不分析就重复旧备忘录中的拒绝。

02eb8a8c01703985.en: Promise new expenditure beyond the approved budget.
02eb8a8c01703985.zh: 承诺超出已批准预算的新支出。

b6bf0abac75cba38.en: All citizens, participating organisations and official documents are fictional. The site and documents are fictional; territorial jurisdiction is assigned to this unit. The validity of the site, contract, route and allocated funding is confirmed. The student does not approve new expenditure or guarantee recycling based solely on a container's colour.
b6bf0abac75cba38.zh: 所有公民、参与机构和公务文件均为虚构。场地与文件为虚构；地域管辖权已划归本部门。场地、合同、路线和已安排资金的有效性均已确认。学生不得批准新支出，也不能仅凭容器颜色保证回收处理。

3a553e90ffdb9160.en: In the original initiative, the chain was missing. Here it is ready, so professional action shifts to organising implementation.
3a553e90ffdb9160.zh: 原倡议缺少完整链条。本情景中链条已具备，因此专业行动转为组织实施。

cce0c4abe4a3b612.en: There was no collection route before the contract was signed. The memo predates the current document package.
cce0c4abe4a3b612.zh: 合同签订前没有清运路线。备忘录日期早于最新材料。

ba36f543715395b1.en: The site is registered, the agreement provides for separate waste accumulation and a dedicated schedule, and the financial terms were approved by the competent party.
ba36f543715395b1.zh: 场地已登记，协议规定分类暂存及独立时间表，财务条件已由有权主体批准。

a98737493c70fc79.en: The carrier and recipient confirmed servicing П-23 according to the waste fractions. Residents have not yet been informed of accepted materials and service days.
a98737493c70fc79.zh: 承运方和接收方已确认按废弃物分类为П-23提供服务。尚未向居民告知可接收物种类和服务日期。

00a212026fed9c52.en: The site conditions and onward route are confirmed; the old objection about absent collection does not address the current stage. In the original initiative, the chain was missing. Here it is ready, so professional action shifts to organising implementation.
00a212026fed9c52.zh: 场地条件及后续路线已获确认；过去关于没有清运安排的理由不适用于当前阶段。原倡议缺少完整链条。本情景中链条已具备，因此专业行动转为组织实施。

e8dd6086b3a6e8d1.en: The site conditions and onward route are confirmed; the old objection about absent collection does not address the current stage.
e8dd6086b3a6e8d1.zh: 场地条件及后续路线已获确认；过去关于没有清运安排的理由不适用于当前阶段。

37f9d40d911c7284.en: The old memo must be repeated regardless of later documents.
37f9d40d911c7284.zh: 无论后来的文件如何，都必须重复旧备忘录。

1cfc7472b551b1f0.en: Confirmation of the route removes the need for information and follow-up.
1cfc7472b551b1f0.zh: 路线确认后便不必告知和监督。

b2b3aa41ee91765c.en: The first trip took place, but its confirmation concerns П-32.
b2b3aa41ee91765c.zh: 首次运输已进行，但确认材料对应的是П-32。

ae4fee5596de5dad.en: Verify performance at П-23 and correct the location error in follow-up.
ae4fee5596de5dad.zh: 核查П-23的执行情况，纠正监督材料中的地点错误。

2a46413979816428.en: Close the task on the basis of any trip by the carrier.
2a46413979816428.zh: 凭承运方任何一次运输就关闭任务。

123a77bfd6cd2f7c.en: Cancel the entire system because of one document.
123a77bfd6cd2f7c.zh: 因一份文件就取消整个系统。

42f89aa18f5aac4c.en: Article 13.4 of Law No. 89-ФЗ links accumulation to compliant sites, provides for separate storage, and requires a scheme and register of municipal solid waste accumulation locations. Siting and procedures take account of federal rules and the procedure established by the region. Container colour alone does not establish accepted waste composition or the onward route. A reception officer does not approve funding or replace the powers of the site owner or operator.
42f89aa18f5aac4c.zh: 第89-ФЗ号法律第13.4条将暂存与符合要求的场地相联系，规定分类存放，以及维护城市生活固体废弃物暂存地点规划和登记册。选址与程序须考虑联邦规则及地区规定。容器颜色本身不能确定可接收废弃物的组成或后续路线。接待工作人员不得批准资金，也不能代替场地所有人或运营方行使职权。

0e3b78928bbdf6af.en: Consider the confirmed location, procedure and route, not just the container's appearance.
0e3b78928bbdf6af.zh: 考虑已确认的地点、程序和路线，而不只看容器外观。

fa8d9d733bf7936e.en: Treat placing a container as sufficient without further organisation.
fa8d9d733bf7936e.zh: 认为放置容器已经足够，不再组织后续工作。

3b6a46523f7c1f38.en: Ignore the completed scheme because of an outdated memo.
3b6a46523f7c1f38.zh: 因过时备忘录而忽视已经具备的方案。

b564c78c6c075221.en: Find the provision 'Locations and procedure for separate waste accumulation'. Specify the document particulars and article, then choose its application.
b564c78c6c075221.zh: 查找“废弃物分类暂存地点与程序”的规定。填写文件信息和条款，再选择其适用方式。

5cb4ef4c91ea1f65.en: We requested containers. They replied that containers were pointless without collection, although a contract and route already exist.
5cb4ef4c91ea1f65.zh: 我们申请放置容器。他们答复说，没有清运安排就没有意义，但合同和路线其实都已有了。

e5e3bef1a60e7579.en: Preparing organisational implementation of conditions already agreed.
e5e3bef1a60e7579.zh: 准备组织落实已商定条件。

de33bffad8bef911.en: A new funding promise by a reception officer.
de33bffad8bef911.zh: 接待工作人员作出新的资金承诺。

133dce6f8301864f.en: Refusal based on an outdated stage without checking the package.
133dce6f8301864f.zh: 不核查材料，根据过时阶段作出拒绝。

13375b0db4b25738.en: Yes, entry П-23 is included in the applicable scheme.
13375b0db4b25738.zh: 是的，条目П-23已纳入适用规划。

e6ececb3c0cdfdb2.en: The contract specifies separate fractions and a particular schedule.
e6ececb3c0cdfdb2.zh: 合同规定了不同分类及具体时间表。

05ac90ee8ac571f1.en: The onward route is not missing.

c19f6676dfacfd17.en: The documents name the recipient and confirm readiness.
c19f6676dfacfd17.zh: 文件列明接收方并确认已准备就绪。

f8585bdccb5f23cf.en: Residents have not been informed of the ready scheme; launch is delayed organisationally.
f8585bdccb5f23cf.zh: 已具备的方案尚未告知居民；启动因组织问题延迟。

39705b226819d0b4.en: The issue is not finding supposedly absent funding.
39705b226819d0b4.zh: 问题不在于寻找所谓缺失的资金。

c5d8b847b2ed2e3a.en: The competent site organiser together with the designated operator and carrier.
c5d8b847b2ed2e3a.zh: 有权负责场地组织的主体，会同已确定的运营方和承运方。

b50898895a948d4c.en: Any company chosen by its refuse truck's colour.
b50898895a948d4c.zh: 按垃圾车颜色选定的任意公司。

ef28e3d823518d58.en: A reception officer acting independently as manager of a new budget.
ef28e3d823518d58.zh: 由接待工作人员独立支配新预算。

669773897a179c76.en: The scheme is already operational; reassess the situation
669773897a179c76.zh: 方案已具备运作条件，需要重新判断

2f46856213566d9f.en: A confirmed route makes checking the first service address unnecessary.
2f46856213566d9f.zh: 路线已确认就不必核查首次服务地址。

2055d3e10af94d97.en: Compare the sticker with the approved list.
2055d3e10af94d97.zh: 将贴纸与已批准清单进行比较。

30968bc2af2f58c9.en: Prepare correction of the instructions on the container.
30968bc2af2f58c9.zh: 准备更正容器旁的说明。

7870535ed4df7464.en: Tell residents the designated route Р-5 and acceptance conditions.
7870535ed4df7464.zh: 向居民说明规定路线Р-5及接收条件。

8650009fabba6c89.en: Do not assign untrained handling of potentially hazardous items.
8650009fabba6c89.zh: 不要安排未经培训人员处理潜在危险物品。

4e13ab7928a10394.en: Check that the sign is current and separate collection is available.
4e13ab7928a10394.zh: 核查标识是否最新、单独接收服务是否可用。

1256717b25f65538.en: Treat the word 'recyclables' as permission for any contents.
1256717b25f65538.zh: 将“可回收物”一词视为允许任何物品的依据。

95e2acb95b0a7c33.en: Send the applicant to sort through the container personally.
95e2acb95b0a7c33.zh: 让申请人自行翻检容器内容物。

f0d1f49a9bc1cbc4.en: All citizens, participating organisations and official documents are fictional. Accepted contents are set by the fictional, explicitly specified rules of this particular scheme: clean, dry packaging on the list. The named lamps and batteries have a separate safe route; the scenario does not propose a universal hazard classification for all such products.
f0d1f49a9bc1cbc4.zh: 所有公民、参与机构和公务文件均为虚构。可接收物由本方案明确列出的虚构规则确定：清单中的清洁干燥包装。所述灯具和电池另有安全处理路径；本情景不对所有此类产品给出统一危险等级分类。

9f73e4eedf53b2f6.en: The original case lacked the entire chain. Here a chain exists for a particular fraction, and the error concerns its contents.
9f73e4eedf53b2f6.zh: 原案例缺少完整链条。本情景已具备特定分类的链条，错误在于可投入物组成。

2eb5f88560bdbe43.en: 'Any recyclables.' No list or exclusions; the sticker's author is unnamed.
2eb5f88560bdbe43.zh: “任何可回收物”。没有清单或排除项；贴纸发布者不明。

dc0036f4feb820ae.en: The listed clean, dry packaging is accepted. The named lamps and batteries are excluded; mixing them with this fraction is not permitted.
dc0036f4feb820ae.zh: 接收清单列明的清洁干燥包装。所述灯具和电池被排除，不允许与该分类混放。

70409c4d346ec2c5.en: Excluded items go to collection point Р-5 under confirmed conditions. A trained contractor handles items already deposited; residents must not sort the contents themselves.
70409c4d346ec2c5.zh: 排除物品应送往条件已确认的接收点Р-5。已误投的物品由受过培训的执行方处理；居民不得自行翻拣内容物。

b3d8ff51163cd8e5.en: The label 'any recyclables' contradicts the К-23 list; correct the information and use the prescribed separate route. The original case lacked the entire chain. Here a chain exists for a particular fraction, and the error concerns its contents.
b3d8ff51163cd8e5.zh: “任何可回收物”的标注与К-23清单矛盾；需要纠正信息并使用规定的单独路线。原案例缺少完整链条。本情景已具备特定分类的链条，错误在于可投入物组成。

a502116e315cf570.en: The label 'any recyclables' contradicts the К-23 list; correct the information and use the prescribed separate route.
a502116e315cf570.zh: “任何可回收物”的标注与К-23清单矛盾；需要纠正信息并使用规定的单独路线。

809bbe3e06c1b9f3.en: Any potentially recyclable item belongs in this container.
809bbe3e06c1b9f3.zh: 任何可能回收的物品都适合放入该容器。

bfed3df82264fb35.en: To correct the error, residents must be required to sort all the contents.
bfed3df82264fb35.zh: 为纠正错误，必须要求居民分拣全部内容物。

fa88c977c8f59fae.en: It emerged that Р-5 no longer accepts one of the named types.
fa88c977c8f59fae.zh: 发现Р-5已停止接收其中一种所述物品。

a087dcbe8a34d1c5.en: Clarify the currently available safe route; do not keep referring to an unavailable service.
a087dcbe8a34d1c5.zh: 核实当前可用的安全路线；不得继续引用不可用服务。

163d8d61958f0146.en: Return the excluded type to the general container without changing the rules.
163d8d61958f0146.zh: 不修改规则就将排除物品重新投入普通容器。

3d06bf66fe6592e4.en: Separate types under the applicable rules and verify the actual conditions of the separate route.
3d06bf66fe6592e4.zh: 按适用规则区分类别，并核查单独路线的实际条件。

96351024dd030d5b.en: Determine accepted contents solely by container colour.
96351024dd030d5b.zh: 仅凭容器颜色决定接收物。

031445aae54f562f.en: Treat all waste as one recyclable fraction.
031445aae54f562f.zh: 将所有废弃物视为同一类可回收物。

2e3d4e364e173c89.en: There is a recycling container at the site. Residents propose putting lamps and batteries into it together with packaging.
2e3d4e364e173c89.zh: 场地上有一个可回收物容器。居民建议把灯具、电池和包装一起投入。

cee263771b8bbfd7.en: Clarifying the fraction's contents and organising safe corrective action.
cee263771b8bbfd7.zh: 明确该分类的组成，并安全组织纠正措施。

63baf152cc9cee96.en: Mixing all waste types under one general label.
63baf152cc9cee96.zh: 以同一总称混放所有废弃物。

e99742562e597d42.en: A dangerous inspection undertaken by the applicant independently.
e99742562e597d42.zh: 由申请人自行开展危险检查。

085b0c4c152f3d36.en: Clean, dry packaging on the posted list.
085b0c4c152f3d36.zh: 公示清单上的清洁干燥包装。

c76785c97f4bad62.en: Contents cannot be inferred from colour alone.
c76785c97f4bad62.zh: 不能仅凭颜色推断接收物组成。

5f6c7a41aead300c.en: On the excluded-items list, with a separate collection point.
5f6c7a41aead300c.zh: 列在排除物品清单中，并设有单独接收点。

fc724d900ad61ab7.en: Where are lamps and batteries listed?

06c6e1f6f731933b.zh: 新贴纸写着“任何可回收物”。

43377ca4084de9d4.en: The instructions contradict the agreed scheme.
43377ca4084de9d4.zh: 说明与已商定方案矛盾。

a825546779c12afc.en: No, a trained contractor must remove hazardous items.
a825546779c12afc.zh: 不需要，危险物品应由受过培训的执行方取出。

33da88d4294bf088.en: Helping must not create a dangerous task for the citizen.
33da88d4294bf088.zh: 提供帮助不应给公民制造危险任务。

f70913b3643f6697.en: Should residents sort the contents by hand?
f70913b3643f6697.zh: 居民是否应手工分拣内容物？

d0b7dfdfb7a146a0.en: The party responsible for the site and the designated operator; excluded items follow the prescribed separate route.
d0b7dfdfb7a146a0.zh: 场地责任方与已确定运营方；排除物品按规定的单独路线处理。

4894d261e1a54dec.en: Any buyer of recyclables without checking their composition.
4894d261e1a54dec.zh: 不核查组成就交给任意废品收购方。

e0ca467b29a01548.en: A resident required to carry out dangerous sorting.
e0ca467b29a01548.zh: 强制居民进行危险分拣。

6d76f25dad838b03.en: Not everything belongs in the blue container
6d76f25dad838b03.zh: 不是所有物品都能进蓝色容器

091ea38d24a49f34.en: A particular fraction's composition is not determined solely by container colour.
091ea38d24a49f34.zh: 特定分类的组成并非仅由容器颜色决定。

886456760983b841.en: Compare the register coordinates and placement report.
886456760983b841.zh: 比较登记册坐标与安放报告。

68e728c4c331c47d.en: Identify the party responsible for the site and changes to the scheme.
68e728c4c331c47d.zh: 确定场地及规划变更的责任方。

78867168b6d8601a.en: Prepare verification and the prescribed correction of placement.
78867168b6d8601a.zh: 准备核查并按规定纠正安放位置。

12b1d994f22ae147.en: Do not suggest that residents move containers without authorisation.
12b1d994f22ae147.zh: 不要建议居民擅自移动容器。

e651fbbd138af434.en: Check the new report against the correct location, not the container count.
e651fbbd138af434.zh: 核查新报告是否对应正确地点，而非仅看容器数量。

0765d03417eb2b3f.en: Accept П-9 as confirmation for П-10.

7405ff36bde02a6a.en: Require citizens to move the containers immediately themselves.
7405ff36bde02a6a.zh: 要求公民立即自行搬运容器。

83f046562eff7f57.en: All citizens, participating organisations and official documents are fictional. The territory is an ordinary municipal district, not a federal city; the materials allocate duties for the accumulation site. Fictional identifiers П-9 and П-10 do not designate real sites. The student does not determine sanitary distances from a drawing or move equipment independently.
83f046562eff7f57.zh: 所有公民、参与机构和公务文件均为虚构。辖区是普通市镇区，而非联邦直辖市；材料已明确暂存地点相关职责。虚构标识П-9和П-10不代表真实场地。学生不得根据图片确定卫生距离，也不得自行搬运设备。

bfe53fa8b16e4ede.en: Here containers and collection are ready, but valid placement is tied to a specific site.
bfe53fa8b16e4ede.zh: 本情景中容器和清运安排已具备，但安放的合法有效性与具体场地绑定。

7e7be83ad4fd3c37.en: Reports only delivery of two containers, without site coordinates.
7e7be83ad4fd3c37.zh: 只报告运达两个容器，没有场地坐标。

46156cc73b9bc85e.en: Accumulation site П-9 is listed with coordinates, contents and a responsible party. The entry does not cover П-10.
46156cc73b9bc85e.zh: 暂存场地П-9列有坐标、组成和责任方。该条目不涵盖П-10。

7256f55603a08f31.en: The containers were placed at П-10 on {{observed}}. No scheme amendment or check of that location's compliance is confirmed; the location discrepancy is established, but specific sanitary violations are not.
7256f55603a08f31.zh: 容器于{{observed}}安放在П-10。尚未确认规划变更或该地点的合规核查；已确定地点偏差，但尚未确认具体卫生违规。

4efd63f3b9e4dd07.en: The П-9 entry does not establish lawful placement at П-10; check the actual location and bring it into compliance with the established procedure. Here containers and collection are ready, but valid placement is tied to a specific site.
4efd63f3b9e4dd07.zh: П-9条目不能证明在П-10安放的合法性；需要核查实际地点并使其符合既定程序。本情景中容器和清运安排已具备，但安放的合法有效性与具体场地绑定。

307dee4cfaa912d0.en: The П-9 entry does not establish lawful placement at П-10; check the actual location and bring it into compliance with the established procedure.
307dee4cfaa912d0.zh: П-9条目不能证明在П-10安放的合法性；需要核查实际地点并使其符合既定程序。

ee448e71e32a91f5.en: Any neighbouring plot is covered by the nearest site's entry.
ee448e71e32a91f5.zh: 任何相邻地块都受最近场地条目涵盖。

0746e19e4bd7a9d3.en: One coordinate discrepancy proves every sanitary violation.
0746e19e4bd7a9d3.zh: 一个坐标偏差就能证明所有卫生违规。

a66bcb47c96d2a9a.en: The report's site name was corrected, but the coordinates and photographs stayed the same.
a66bcb47c96d2a9a.zh: 报告更正了场地名称，但坐标和照片仍旧不变。

dadd38572ccc16eb.en: Verify the actual correction, not just a changed report caption.
dadd38572ccc16eb.zh: 核查实际纠正情况，而不只是报告标注的修改。

216d03453ee027cb.en: Recognise correction based on a new heading.
216d03453ee027cb.zh: 凭新标题就认可已纠正。

b2ef74d06daa38ba.en: Delete the earlier materials so the reports do not conflict.
b2ef74d06daa38ba.zh: 删除早期材料，以免报告相互矛盾。

b96bd9bf5eed1238.en: Match the location to its register entry; changing a caption does not replace actual performance.
b96bd9bf5eed1238.zh: 核对地点与登记条目；修改标注不能替代实际执行。

9a9ba7769c92bdd0.en: Extend the entry to neighbouring plots without grounds.
9a9ba7769c92bdd0.zh: 无依据地将条目范围扩大到相邻地块。

fee3b56d6e2b0972.en: Assess the site solely by the number of containers delivered.
fee3b56d6e2b0972.zh: 仅凭运到的容器数量评价场地。

6fc0af388a84c9c5.en: They promised containers by our building but placed them on the neighbouring plot. The reply says the site is already in the register.
6fc0af388a84c9c5.zh: 原本承诺将容器放在我们楼旁，却放到了相邻地块。答复说场地已经在登记册中。

abc63640ab63ff93.en: Checking the accumulation location, scheme and established correction procedure.
abc63640ab63ff93.zh: 核查暂存地点、规划和规定的纠正程序。

118917a4773cabfb.en: Closing the issue solely because the containers were delivered.
118917a4773cabfb.zh: 仅因容器已运到就结束事项。

0e6246e0758704e3.en: Unauthorised relocation by citizens to a place of their choice.
0e6246e0758704e3.zh: 公民擅自搬至自行选择的地点。

cc77eb2bc536882f.en: At П-10, nearby but outside the approved plot.
cc77eb2bc536882f.zh: 在П-10，虽在附近，但超出了获批地块边界。

841170784a9536b1.en: It is not confirmed in the case.

a889fc3ed9e61808.zh: 需要核查实际安放位置。

4e53017ae3ece6d3.en: There is no expert finding; the applicant shows only a location difference.
4e53017ae3ece6d3.zh: 没有专业结论；申请人仅指出了地点差异。

2303b3a3a4534683.en: There are no grounds to independently assert a specific exceedance.
2303b3a3a4534683.zh: 没有依据自行认定具体超标。

28d6f12f8b426b3a.en: The authorised municipal organiser of the accumulation site, with those responsible for placement.
28d6f12f8b426b3a.zh: 有权负责暂存场地组织的市镇主体，会同安放责任方。

560b48aa1093d745.en: Only the driver who delivered the containers.
560b48aa1093d745.zh: 仅由运送容器的司机负责。

4b61a248c2082de4.en: Any resident acting as an authority for amending the scheme.
4b61a248c2082de4.zh: 由任意居民充当规划变更机关。

517bdb53d5ed9186.en: The container was delivered to the neighbouring plot
517bdb53d5ed9186.zh: 容器被送到了相邻地块

74b4346b6b08b15e.en: An entry for П-9 alone does not confirm placement at П-10.
74b4346b6b08b15e.zh: 仅有П-9条目，不能确认在П-10的安放。

201fdf69e4e7b6ae.en: All citizens, appeals and official materials are fictional. Training documents are not real regulations. No actual messages are sent or calls made.
201fdf69e4e7b6ae.zh: 所有公民、申诉和公务材料均为虚构。教学文件不是真实规程。不会实际发送消息或拨打电话。

30a2897ebafe90d4.en: The same story is available in two modes. In learning mode, a mentor explains decisions. In independent work, your choices are recorded and the mark is calculated after the shift. The employee's role is specified separately in each case.
30a2897ebafe90d4.zh: 同一故事提供两种模式。学习模式中，导师解释决定；独立作业模式记录您的选择，结束本轮后计算成绩。每个案件分别说明工作人员的角色。

38dfc88155db226a.en: Tax Code: audits and calculation of periods
38dfc88155db226a.zh: 税法典：检查与期限计算

7b62511deefd43da.en: The general rule gives an ordinary desk audit of an original return a three-month period. Special regimes and amended returns are considered separately. Months are not replaced by 90 days; the end date is determined under Article 6.1.
7b62511deefd43da.zh: 一般规则下，对原始申报进行普通案头税务检查的期限为三个月。特别制度和更正申报另行处理。月份不能替换为90天；截止日期按第6.1条确定。

98f7fcd46988eae4.en: Training extract: Articles 10 and 10.1. Check the version applicable on the case date.
98f7fcd46988eae4.zh: 教学摘录：第10及10.1条。请核查案件日期适用的版本。
